text:
zoe: heads-up — support ticket: tenant claims they set X-Embed-Dims=1536 but got billed 6x expected.

sam: could you paste a sanitized request + preflight logs?

zoe: sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $$$' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -H 'X-Embed-Dims: 1536' \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-v2","input":["short a","short b","<blob ~9KB>","short c"]}'
```

zoe: preflight/logs: 
```
preflight: items=4, sample_lens=[9,10,9200,8]
preflight: header_dims=1536
preflight: sampled_inferred=[1536,1536,8192,1536]
routing: split -> [fastpath, fastpath, slowpath, fastpath]
estimate: used_header_units=4*48=192
quota: billed_units=48+48+1024+48=1168
```

mike: yup — same class of issue we've seen. We compute estimates from header quickly but routing uses per-item inference, so mixed batches blow past the estimate. Console shows wrong early estimate and customers panic.

mike: proposal: do a cheap sampled-infer step (first N items or first K bytes) synchronously to pick a more accurate estimate, but keep heavy inference async. Also provide an async reconciliation path that emits an audit correction and console adjustment if final != initial estimate by >2x.

sam: implementation sketch: feature flag embed.estimate_mode with values `header_only|sync_sample|async_reconcile`. Default header_only for now. Canary `sync_sample` for 5% tenants, `async_reconcile` as a safer opt-in first. Sampling limits: up to 6 items or 12KB, skip sampling if any item >100KB.

sam: telemetry to add: metric `embed.estimate_mode`, counter `embed.sample_attempts`, `embed.sample_mismatch_count`, histogram `estimate_vs_final_ratio`, and trace tag `embed.estimate_source=header|sampled|reconciled`. Also emit tenant_id in metrics for dashboarding.

billing-bot: BILL-781 created to review auto-credit rules for large reconciliation deltas.

console-bot: UI asks: add request-trace badge `header_mismatch=true` when reconciliation changes estimate, and a time-series annotation point `estimate_adjusted` so support can see when values changed. Add per-tenant alert when mismatch_rate > 0.5%/day.

zoe: support will notify affected tenants and publish a short doc "How to set X-Embed-Dims and avoid surprises". We'll also add an SDK helper to compute dims client-side for common languages.

ops-bot: INF-3044 created: "embed: sampled estimate + async reconciliation to avoid header mismatch billing" assigned to @sam and @mike.

sam: plan: implement `async_reconcile` first (no latency impact), emit telemetry and console badge. If it looks good, enable `sync_sample` for canary set to reduce surprise estimates. Rollout window: canary 48h, monitor estimate_vs_final_ratio and any increased preflight CPU.

mike: ack. add safeguard: never sample more than 12KB or 6 items to keep cost bounded. Also don't run sampling for requests flagged as high_priority (to preserve latency).

zoe: thanks — I'll attach links to the support thread and the raw logs in the ticket.
